The '''''King's Ransom''''' was a [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Jessica Meade]].

==Description==
[[File:Kings_ransom_stern.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''King's Ransom'' and its [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] escort, under attack by pirates.]]

The ''King's Ransom'' was a [[fuel transporter]],<ref name="TPOTADA" /> designed with its cockpit area underneath the tank area. The ship could be flown by just one person. The vessel had multiple [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] fitted to the side of the cockpit area. The transporter model had two landing gears.<ref name="TPOT" />

==History==
The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] served as part of the [[Tammuz-an shipping fleet]]. It was later given to Meade as thanks for her part in helping [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mon Julpa]] secure his throne.<ref name="TNK">{{DroidsCite|The New King}}</ref>
Meade used the vessel to transport cargo shipments for [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]]. During a trip carrying fuel for the [[Tammuz-an space navy]], the ''Ransom'' was hijacked by pirates under the command of [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]].
When Meade later escaped from the pirate's base on [[Tarnoonga/Legends|Tarnoonga]], the pirates made chase and destroyed the vessel with their captured [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Demolisher]]'', prior to Ren-Cha's [[Battle of Tammuz-an|assault]] on Tammuz-an.<ref name="TPOT" />
